scenes.card: Voting polls|Run a secret-ballot election in minutes
scenes.text: In this video you will learn how to run a voting poll with NTSOne. Create a poll, build its ballot, open voting, and watch the results arrive live.

scenes.title: 1. Create a poll
scenes.text: Open Voting Polls and choose New Poll. Give it a name and a description. Then decide whether voters need an account. If they do, they sign up and confirm their email. If not, anyone with the link can vote straight away, and each browser counts as one voter.

scenes.title: 2. Build the ballot
scenes.text: Next, open the Ballot tab and add a position, such as President. Add a candidate for each person on the ballot, with an optional photo and short description. Then save the ballot.

scenes.title: 3. Choose the rules
scenes.text: On the Overview tab you choose the rules. You can allow one vote per email, show live results to voters, be emailed about each vote, and decide whether voters must create an account.

scenes.title: 4. Open voting
scenes.text: When everything is ready, press Open voting. You can also set a time for the poll to close by itself. Voting can be free, or you can ask voters to pay for their votes with the paid voting settings, and agree to the platform fee first.

scenes.title: 5. The voter's view
scenes.text: This is what a voter sees. They open the link, choose one candidate for each position, and press Vote. They are thanked straight away, and if you allow it, the live results update as people vote.

scenes.title: 6. Polls with voter accounts
scenes.text: When a poll asks for accounts, voters first sign in or create an account. You can also limit voting to certain email domains, or to a list of verified voters.

scenes.title: 7. Results and voters
scenes.text: The Results tab shows each candidate's votes, percentage and place, and you can export them. The Voters tab shows who voted, but never who they voted for, because the ballot stays secret.
That is how you run a voting poll with NTSOne. Use this video as your guide, and watch the next video to learn about businesses.
